Then we can compute the difference to double it. But we cannot guarantee we can add that much because tank capacity is 50 gallons. If current fuel is >25 gallons, doubling would exceed capacity. So we need to check. We can call displayCarStatus to get current fuel. Then decide how much to add. If current fuel <=25, we can add same amount. If >25, we can only fill to max. So we can call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to min(currentFuel, 50 - currentFuel). But we need to get currentFuel. Let's call displayCarStatus.
